meta.archive_selection: every archive file ending in 'USD' whose first and last trade are at least 2 years apart
meta.method: acsoe.research.historical.read_archive_rows + to_frame, then acsoe.research.labelling.label_frame at config/default.yaml's barriers (+3% / -1.5% / 48 bars), one pair at a time
meta.note: Past-only walk-forward folds at the committed backtest settings, for the three pairs the retired two-sided table was measured on.
